topic: A helicopter flew 72 times on Mars
claim: NASA's Ingenuity helicopter was planned for no more than five test flights in 30 days, and flew 72 times over nearly three years.

beats.caption: Built for 5 flights. It flew 72.
beats.vo: Built for five flights. It flew seventy-two.

beats.caption: Planned: 5 flights in 30 days
beats.vo: Ingenuity was a tech test. NASA planned no more than five flights in thirty days, on a planet where the air is less than one percent as dense as Earth's.

beats.caption: April 2021 to January 2024
beats.vo: It took off on April nineteenth, twenty twenty-one, the first powered flight on another planet. Its last flight was January eighteenth, twenty twenty-four.

beats.caption: 128.8 minutes in the air
beats.vo: In all, it spent one hundred twenty-eight point eight minutes flying, covering seventeen kilometers.

beats.caption: 72 flights. Planned: 5.
beats.vo: It scouted terrain for the Perseverance rover and paved the way for future aerial explorers. A five-flight plan, seventy-two flights. What should fly on Mars next?
